acceptanceCriteria: `queue status` and `plan preview` started inside a writer's receipt-to-head window succeed on the new head once the writer finishes, within a bounded wait, instead of reporting NOT_RUN/REDO_PENDING at once.

A moved snapshot is paused on and re-read within the same budget; only a writer that outlives the budget ends REDO_PENDING or SNAPSHOT_MOVED, and that failure names the wait and says the read is retryable.
The waiting read writes and locks nothing (product invariant 4): the store is byte-identical after a read that gave up.
Covered by maintained tests in internal/tasks/snapshot and internal/tasks/cli, with the spec requirement traced in docs/specs/REQUIREMENTS.tsv.
body: GitHub issue beamfall/corvint#433 (owner, 2026-10-01). Reproduction: about ten agents running corvint-tasks mutations concurrently; a read-only `corvint-tasks queue status` or `plan preview` returns NOT_RUN with code REDO_PENDING (also SNAPSHOT_MOVED, per the issue comment); retrying about two seconds later succeeds. Version: corvint-tasks 0.0.0-tcp01-unverified+build.202 on Core at ff3da727e95a1999cbc4a58a471cdd498693f902. Expected: a healthy store with a writer in flight is not a failed read; the condition is retryable and the reader should wait it out. Actual: snapshot.Reader.Read reported a probe-level REDO_PENDING at once and retried a moved snapshot three times back to back with no pause, so a read landing in the section 5.2 window between receipt link-in and head rename, or straddling consecutive commits, failed. The issue's `outcome: ERROR` came from the external dispatcher; outcomeFor already maps both codes to NOT_RUN. Fix: spec requirement CTS-V0-006 (docs/specs/corvint-tasks-store-init-v0.md), bounded patience with backoff in internal/tasks/snapshot/probe.go, build-log docs/build-log/2026-10-01-tasks-read-waits-for-in-flight-writer.md, branch claude/i433-read-redo-pending. Related: V1-0309 (panel F2, readers report in-flight writers as crashes).
title: corvint-tasks: read-only queue status and plan preview fail REDO_PENDING or SNAPSHOT_MOVED during a concurrent write (issue 433)
